exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) followed by hysteroscopic resection
high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) followed by hysteroscopic resection
cohort: 94 women who underwent either HIFU or UAE followed by hysteroscopic resection for retained placenta accreta
finding: Both HIFU and UAE combined with hysteroscopic resection appear to be safe and effective procedures for treating retained placenta accreta.
